title: Go for the WIN! The Selling Power of Sports + TV

facts.fact: According to the EDO report cited on the page, women's sports viewership increased 131% in 2024.
facts.quote: fueled by a 131% increase in viewership in 2024.

facts.fact: According to the EDO report cited on the page, women's sports ads brought 40% more ad impact than the average primetime ad in the prior year.
facts.quote: Women’s sports ads also brought 40% more ad impact than the average primetime ad last year.

facts.fact: The page's summary of women's sports coverage says the majority of advertising impressions occur between March and October on both broadcast and cable providers.
facts.quote: The majority of activity is between March and October on both broadcast and cable providers.

facts.fact: The article was posted on June 18, 2025, by Rob Bochicchio of Centriply.
